description: Received commission income ₹12,000 by SBI Bank cheque for agency services rendered
narration: Being commission income received via bank cheque
explanation: Standard revenue receipt: Debit SBI Bank Asset A/c Dr ₹12,000, Credit Commission Income A/c Cr ₹12,000.

description: Bank Fixed Deposit interest ₹8,500 earned for April 2026 but unreceived/uncredited at month end
narration: Being accrued interest income earned on bank fixed deposit recorded as current asset
explanation: Accrued Revenue: Debit Accrued Interest Asset A/c Dr ₹8,500 (Current Asset), Credit Interest Income A/c Cr ₹8,500 (matching period revenue).

description: Consultancy services worth ₹25,000 completed for client TechCorp in April, but bill unpaid at month end
narration: Being accrued consultancy service revenue earned recorded as current asset
explanation: Accrued Service Income: Debit Accrued Service Fee Asset A/c Dr ₹25,000, Credit Consultancy Fee Revenue A/c Cr ₹25,000.

description: Received SBI Bank cheque ₹8,500 from bank against previously accrued fixed deposit interest
narration: Being payment received against previously accrued bank fixed deposit interest
explanation: Realizing Asset Receivable: Debit SBI Bank Asset A/c Dr ₹8,500, Credit Accrued Interest Asset A/c Cr ₹8,500 (clearing asset).

description: Received 6 months advance shop rent ₹36,000 in cash from sub-tenant Mr. Roy for May to October 2026
creditAccount: Unearned Rent / Rent Received in Advance (Current Liability)
narration: Being 6 months advance sub-let shop rent received in cash recorded as unearned liability
explanation: Unearned Revenue Liability: Debit Cash Asset A/c Dr ₹36,000, Credit Rent Received in Advance Liability A/c Cr ₹36,000.

description: Recognized 1 month's earned rent (₹6,000) out of advance rent liability at month end 31-May-2026
debitAccount: Unearned Rent / Rent Received in Advance (Current Liability)
narration: Being earned portion of advance rent transferred from liability to Rent Income Account
explanation: Adjusting Unearned Revenue: Debit Rent Received in Advance Liability A/c Dr ₹6,000 (reducing liability), Credit Rent Income A/c Cr ₹6,000 (recognizing earned revenue).

description: Dividend income ₹14,000 declared on corporate shares investment earned but unreceived at month end
narration: Being accrued dividend income earned on investment shares recorded
explanation: Accrued Income: Debit Accrued Dividend Asset A/c ₹14,000, Credit Dividend Income A/c ₹14,000.

description: Received 3 months advance client retainer fee ₹45,000 by SBI Bank cheque for advisory project
narration: Being 3 months advance client retainer fee received recorded as liability
explanation: Unearned Income: Debit SBI Bank Asset A/c ₹45,000, Credit Unearned Retainer Fee Liability A/c ₹45,000.

description: Received cash ₹25,000 from client TechCorp against previously accrued consultancy service bill
narration: Being cash received against previously accrued consultancy fee receivable
explanation: Realizing Asset: Debit Cash Asset A/c ₹25,000, Credit Accrued Service Fee Asset A/c ₹25,000.

description: Recognized 1 month's earned retainer fee (₹15,000 out of ₹45,000 advance) at month end 30-Apr-2026
narration: Being earned portion of advance retainer fee transferred to revenue
explanation: Adjusting Unearned Revenue: Debit Unearned Retainer Fee Liability A/c ₹15,000, Credit Advisory Fee Revenue A/c ₹15,000.
